Hi Logan — thanks for the ping and for including the portal screenshot. Summary / recommended response below.

Current state (authoritative artifact):
- The only signed final SOC 2 Type II we have issued to date covers the period 2024-01-01 to 2024-09-30 and is published as RW-SOC2-2024-FINAL.pdf (issued 2025-08-12).
- The file RW-SOC2-2025-TypeII-draft.pdf is an internal draft that was accidentally uploaded to the external portal on 2026-10-30 by an associate during document refresh. That draft is not signed and should not be treated as authoritative. We've removed the draft from the external portal and will replace the entry with the correct file.

Reissue / bridge status: 
- We do not yet have a completed signed reissue for a 2025 audit period. Our external auditor experienced a scheduling delay which prevented signature capture in Q3/Q4. The auditor is targeting a formal reissued/updated Type II (label: RW-SOC2-2025-TypeII-REISSUE.pdf) with signatures by 2026-11-29.
- As an interim measure we will provide a formal bridge letter that explicitly states coverage through 2026-06-30 and includes the auditor name and expected reissue date. A bridge draft (SOC2_Bridge_Draft_20261121.docx) is attached; we will finalize and sign the bridge within 24–48 hours.

Control changes / exceptions:
- There have been no material control changes since the last final report that would impact user-entity controls for production services. Minor operational tuning (batch sizing and caching behavior) was implemented in Mar 2026; these are documented but not material to SOC control assertions.

Recommended reply to customer (for you to send):
- Confirm RW-SOC2-2024-FINAL.pdf is the signed authoritative artifact.
- Explain that an internal draft was mistakenly uploaded and that it has been removed.
- Offer the bridge letter (attach Drive link to signed bridge when ready) that covers 2025-07-01 through 2026-06-30 and mention the expected reissued Type II will be available by 2026-11-29.
- Offer to provide the auditor name/signature block and any required attestation language.

I'll finalize the bridge doc tonight and route for signature tomorrow morning. Attachments I'm pushing to Drive: RW-SOC2-2024-FINAL.pdf (signed final), SOC2_Bridge_Final_20261122.pdf (pending signatures), and internal_auditor_note.txt (brief note on auditor status).

Let me know if you want me to reply directly to Emily or if you'd prefer to send.

— Neha Kapoor
Director, Compliance & Trust
Redwood Inference
